question: Who is the founder of 'Youth Strike 4 Climate' movement which was also nominated for the Nobel Peace Prize?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Greta Thunberg**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Greta Thunberg** is the founder of the 'Youth Strike 4 Climate' movement.
 
• She started this movement by striking outside the Swedish parliament in August 2018 to demand stronger action on climate change.
 
• The movement has inspired millions of students around the world to participate in climate strikes and protests.
 
• Greta Thunberg was nominated for the Nobel Peace Prize for her efforts to bring global attention to climate change and the urgency of addressing it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Greta Thunberg** was born on 3rd January 2003 in Stockholm, Sweden.
 
• She has received numerous awards and recognitions for her climate activism, including being named Time Magazine's Person of the Year in 2019.
 
• Greta has addressed the United Nations, the European Parliament, and various other international forums, urging leaders to take immediate and substantial action to combat climate change.
 
• Her activism has sparked a global movement, with students and activists around the world joining her in demanding climate justice.
 
• In addition to her activism, Greta has authored a book titled "**No One Is Too Small to Make a Difference**", which is a collection of her speeches.
